:::{#def-cohen-kappa}
#### Cohen's kappa

For an agent and a reference with [chance agreement](#def-chance-agreement) $p_e < 1$,
**Cohen's kappa** is the agreement beyond chance,
as a fraction of the largest possible agreement beyond chance,
built from the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) $p_o$
and the chance agreement $p_e$:

$$\kappa \eqdef \frac{p_o - p_e}{1 - p_e}$$ {#eq-cohen-kappa}

Source: @cohen1960coefficient; @wikipedia_cohens_kappa.

:::
